articles.title: You don’t need to believe in a god to get a religious exemption from using AI at work
articles.summary: David Durman, a University of Kentucky administrator, recently earned a religious exemption from using AI in the workplace.

articles.title: Andy Jassy says Prime Video is on track to earn ‘tens of billions of dollars’
articles.summary: The success of blockbuster hits like "Project Hail Mary" and "Verity" is only part of the story, Amazon's CEO says.

articles.title: AWS will be a $1T business, Jassy says — but first, it will spend big
articles.summary: Amazon wants to be the king of AI cloud computing and become the first $1 trillion revenue business. But to do that it will have to continue on its capex spending spree, its CEO said Thursday.

articles.title: Binance pauses withdrawals as hackers suspected of stealing billions in crypto
articles.summary: Some estimates say hackers stole billions in crypto from Binance, the world's largest cryptocurrency exchange, during a cyberattack on Thursday.

articles.title: Elon Musk is ‘truly a genius,’ says Vladimir Putin
articles.summary: Putin said that he and Musk are in "close contact" about Rassvet, Russia's Starlink-like satellite connectivity project.

articles.title: Amazon reported booming cloud revenue but otherwise missed expectations
articles.summary: The biggest ouch of the report was its negative free cash flow of $2.4 billion.

articles.title: GM reaches $220M settlement over selling drivers’ private data
articles.summary: As part of the settlement, GM must get drivers’ express consent before it collects or shares their driving and location data.

articles.title: Fan-fiction site Archive of Our Own (AO3) could be offline for up to 4 weeks after security incident
articles.summary: The site has such a passionate user base that, within two hours of the announcement, its status page's posts had garnered millions of views (and much panicked commentary) across social media.

articles.title: Series B Funding Is Up, But Fewer Deals Are Getting Done
articles.summary: Crunchbase data shows that so far this year, investors have poured around $48 billion into financings around the Series B stage, the highest tally in years. Yet round counts are below year-ago levels and are on track for a multiyear low. We take a look at the data.

articles.title: Jumbo Series A Rounds Hiding The Real Squeeze On Seed Startups
articles.summary: AI megarounds are masking a shrinking Series A market, leaving seed founders facing higher revenue expectations and longer timelines despite larger seed checks. To improve their chances, MGV's Marc Schröder says, founders should size their seed funding around Series A milestones.

articles.title: Serbia’s Gen Z takes back their country from strongman Vucic, demanding top police, intelligence, judiciary officials resign immediately
articles.summary: The students' win on Sunday marks the first time that a grass-root youth movement toppled a well-established political leader.

articles.title: The $6.3 billion Binance hack: What we know so far about the biggest crypto heist in history
articles.summary: There are unconfirmed reports North Korea is behind the massive hack.

articles.title: Trump is still defying judge’s orders by banning media access, CNN, MS NOW and Politico say
articles.summary: The most recent filing asks the court to make those previous orders permanent.

articles.title: Weakened Netanyahu spreads claims of malfeasance by Arab-led parties as his party claims Israel’s election was ‘stolen’
articles.summary: The opposition accused Netanyahu of demonizing the Arab population after a historic showing by Arab-led parties in an attempt to delegitimize the election.

articles.title: Spanish PM, facing reelection, says it’s ‘unacceptable’ to suffer two high-speed rail accidents in one year as at least 68 die in collision
articles.summary: Pedro Sánchez called for increased safety measures to restore confidence in a high-speed rail system that was once a source of national pride.

articles.title: Grandson of Reese’s inventor says Hershey is selling a ‘total imitation’ of the candy recipe. The rest of the family insists it tastes the same
articles.summary: Hershey says it will bring back the classic recipe in 2027. Brad Reese calls that ‘a stall,’ but his cousins say he speaks for no one.

articles.title: Alphabet just had its worst day as a public company. BofA now values Google search at a lower multiple than fossil fuel stocks
articles.summary: Search revenue missed forecasts and free cash flow went negative. Bank of America now values Google’s core search business at about 10 times earnings, against 18.7 for the S&P 500.

articles.title: Amazon CEO says shopping agents like Meta’s Muse ‘not great’
articles.summary: In September, Amazon blocked Meta’s popular new AI assistant from accessing its online store.
